name: companion-import-catalogs
description: Spell (magias5e) and item (SRD 5.2.1) catalog importers. No dependencies. main points at run-tests.mjs (imports every *.test.mjs) so `node --test scripts/import-catalogs/` works on Node 22+ (directory resolved as a module) as well as Node 20 (directory scanned for *.test.mjs).
